a2-196.title: Communicative Challenge: In the Queue
a2-196.scenario: Máté and Anna are in a long queue at the ticket office in the Castle District. Anna has just arrived and asks Máté (you) how the queue looks.
a2-196.prompt: Tell Anna that a tall man is standing in front of you and that she is standing behind you.
cues: Say who is standing in front of you
a2-196.target: Előttem áll egy magas férfi, mögöttem te állsz.
a2-196.english: A tall man is standing in front of me, you are standing behind me.
a2-196.canDo: I can inflect spatial postpositions with personal suffixes (előttem, mögötted, mellette).

a2-197.title: Communicative Challenge: Noisy Neighbours
a2-197.scenario: Anna is telling Máté about her flat in Budapest. You are Anna and you complain about the noise upstairs.
a2-197.prompt: Tell Máté that the neighbours live right above you (and your family), and ask him to keep it between the two of you.
cues: Ask him to keep it secret
a2-197.target: A szomszédok pontosan felettünk laknak. Ez maradjon köztünk!
a2-197.english: The neighbours live right above us. Let this stay between us!
a2-197.canDo: I can use inflected vertical and relational postpositions (alattam, felettünk, köztünk).

a2-198.title: Communicative Challenge: Don't Go Without Me
a2-198.scenario: Máté and Anna are about to leave the café in the Castle District, but Máté (you) still has to pay. Anna is already standing up.
a2-198.prompt: Ask Anna not to leave without you, and tell her that your colleague is working instead of you this evening.
cues: Ask her not to leave without you
Say who is working instead of you
a2-198.target: Kérlek, ne menj el nélkülem! Ma este a kollégám dolgozik helyettem.
a2-198.english: Please, don't leave without me! Tonight my colleague is working instead of me.
a2-198.canDo: I can use inflected forms of nélkül (nélkülem, nélküled) and helyett (helyettem, helyette).

a2-199.title: Communicative Challenge: Don't Worry About Me
a2-199.scenario: Máté has missed his train and phones Anna from the station. You are Máté and Anna is worried.
a2-199.prompt: Tell Anna not to worry about you and that your brother is coming to the station by car to pick you up.
cues: Say who is coming to pick you up and how
a2-199.target: Ne aggódj miattam! A bátyám autóval kijön értem az állomásra.
a2-199.english: Don't worry about me! My brother is coming out to the station by car to pick me up.
a2-199.canDo: I can use miattam, miattad (because of me, you) and értem, érted (for me, you).

a2-200.title: Communicative Challenge: Follow Me
a2-200.scenario: Anna shows Máté the way through the busy streets of the Castle District. You are Anna and you lead the way.
a2-200.prompt: Tell Máté to follow you, and then to sit down next to you on the bench for a rest.
cues: Tell him to sit down next to you
a2-200.target: Gyere utánam! Ülj le mellém a padra, pihenjünk egy kicsit!
a2-200.english: Follow me! Sit down beside me on the bench, let's rest a bit!
a2-200.canDo: I can use position and movement forms such as mellettem and mellém, előttem and elém, and utánam.

a2-200-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Meet Me at the Station
a2-200-consolidation.scenario: Máté phones Anna while she is leaving the Castle District. You are Máté and you arrive by train later.
a2-200-consolidation.prompt: Ask Anna not to leave without you, and tell her that your friend is coming to meet you at the station.
cues: Ask her not to leave without you
Say who is coming to meet you
a2-200-consolidation.target: Ne menj el nélkülem! A barátom elém jön az állomásra.
a2-200-consolidation.english: Don't leave without me! My friend is coming to meet me at the station.
a2-200-consolidation.canDo: I can use the inflected postpositions of this unit (előttem, nélkülem, helyettem, miattam, utánam).
